findings.current:
“You know what I mean.”

“Of course. But before we wipe them all out in one place, we should go after Jin Taekyung right now—”
findings.defect: The draft removes a turn and assigns Baek Yeon’s proposal to So Gyo, reversing who argues for acting against Jin immediately.
findings.rationale: Baek confirms his question, So Gyo says he already has an idea, and Baek then proposes targeting Jin.
findings.replacement:
“That’s right.”

“You must have guessed already.”

“Of course I have. But before we wipe them all out in one place, we should go after Jin Taekyung right now—”
findings.source:
“그렇소.”

“당신도 이미 짐작하고 있을 텐데?”

“물론이오. 그러나 놈들을 한자리에서 일망타진(一網打盡)하는 것보다 먼저 지금 당장 진태경부터…….”

findings.defect: East-northeast changes the stated direction; the source says east-west.

findings.current: The Embroidered Uniform Guard soldiers grumbled as they gazed up at the sky from beneath the eaves.
findings.defect: The draft identifies these soldiers as members of the Embroidered Uniform Guard, but the source calls them imperial guards, distinguishing them from the 금의위 stationed earlier.
findings.rationale: 금위군 and 금의위 are different designations in this passage.
findings.replacement: The imperial guards grumbled as they gazed up at the sky from beneath the eaves.
findings.source: 처마 밑에서 하늘을 바라보며 투덜거리던 금위군들은 꿈에도 몰랐을 것이다.

findings.current: “They won’t. And there’s no way they’ll be in a position to. You heard everything yourself, so you know that.”
findings.defect: The draft turns Jin’s assessment of the situation into a claim that the watchers cannot catch him.
findings.rationale: 그럴 상황도 아니고 refers to the circumstances, which the following exchange explains through the enemy’s plan; it does not say the watchers are unable to act.
findings.replacement: “They won’t. Not in this situation. You were there and heard it too, so you know.”
findings.source: “그럴 일 없어. 그럴 상황도 아니고. 너도 옆에서 들었으니까 알잖아.”

findings.current: As an enormous, unseen force shook the air, two objects buried deep in the ground shot up into So Gyo’s hands.
findings.defect: Calling the 기운 an unspecified force loses the Murim qi mechanism of So Gyo’s action.
findings.rationale: The source names 기운 rather than an unspecified external force.
findings.replacement: As an enormous, unseen surge of qi shook the air, two objects buried deep in the ground shot up into So Gyo’s hands.
findings.source: 보이지 않는 거대한 기운이 공기를 뒤흔듦과 동시에, 땅 깊숙이 박혀 있던 두 개의 물체가 솟구치듯 소교의 양손에 잡혔다.

findings.current: Their edges curved gently toward the tips.
findings.defect: The draft makes the edges specifically curved, while the source describes the objects’ overall curve toward their tips.
findings.rationale: 곡선 describes their curved shape without specifying an edge.
findings.replacement: Each also curved gently toward its tip.
findings.source: 거기에 더해 끝으로 갈수록 부드럽게 휘어진 곡선까지.

summary: The draft has a misassigned dialogue exchange, an altered direction, and a guard-unit mix-up, along with smaller losses of meaning.
